proof: With balanced common weather and shared controls/trend, sector differences eliminate the shared nuisances. A ONE-temperature slope contrast has date score a_t times residual differences; those residual-difference columns are orthogonal to [1,T], so their rank and covariance rank are at most T−2. This special argument does not cover stacked feature weights or shared unit-varying AR controls.
scope: All 216 annual-crisis ONE-temperature equality tests only; no source/result mutation and no assertion that T−2 is a universal multi-feature bound.
